name: Harbor View Hotel - Martha's Vineyard
insider_take: This historic waterfront gem sits in the heart of Edgartown's captains' district, where whaling fortunes built stunning Greek Revival mansions that still line the tree-shaded streets.
whats_special: The Harbor View Hotel occupies prime real estate overlooking Edgartown Harbor and Chappaquiddick Island, originally built in 1891 during Martha's Vineyard's golden age. The hotel's lighthouse suite offers panoramic views of the same waters where Jaws was filmed, and you're just steps from the Edgartown Lighthouse that's been guiding sailors since 1828.
pro_tip: Book a harbor-facing room during the summer regatta season to witness the spectacular sight of hundreds of sailboats racing across Nantucket Sound right from your window.
dont_miss: Take the tiny Chappaquiddick Ferry (it holds just 3 cars!) across to Mytoi, a hidden Japanese garden oasis, or stroll down North Water Street to see the "Gingerbread Cottages" - Victorian homes so perfectly preserved they look like a movie set. The nearby Whaling Church, with its soaring spire visible from miles at sea, hosts concerts in one of New England's most acoustically perfect spaces.
pros: Prime waterfront location with stunning harbor views
Historic charm in prestigious Edgartown setting
Walking distance to Edgartown's shops and restaurants
Classic New England coastal elegance and ambiance
cons: Seasonal destination with limited winter availability
